parsed.post: New best: 0.846063. Increasing data volume to all shards significantly helped. Next: testing a lower learning rate to refine convergence and investigating if a smaller batch size provides more updates within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.01 for finer convergence and halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget.
